lines.en: label toukafirsthall:
scene toukahall1
: Good evening, Sensei. Do you have some sort of business in the girls’ dorm?
lines.zh: : 晚上好，Sensei。你来女生宿舍是有什么事吗？

lines.en: : Hey. Nope. I’m just here to hang out.
lines.zh: : 嘿。没事。我就是来逛逛。

lines.en: scene toukahall2
: Hang out? Forgive me if I’m misunderstanding the full meaning of this popular common phrase, but wouldn’t that imply you are here for the express purpose of being around [young_girls]?
lines.zh: : 逛逛？如果我误解了这句流行口语的全部含义，还请见谅——但「逛逛」岂不是意味着你来这儿的明确目的，就是待在[年轻女孩们]身边？

lines.en: : Yes. It would.
lines.zh: : 对。是这个意思。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 原来如此。

lines.en: : And forgive me if I am misunderstanding even more, but wouldn’t that imply that you have some rather unfavorable affinities for a man of your age?
lines.zh: : 如果我误解得更离谱，也还请见谅——但那岂不是意味着，就你这个年纪的男人而言，你的「癖好」相当见不得人？

lines.en: : Again, yes. Yes it would.
lines.zh: : 还是那句。对，就是这样。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 原来如此。

lines.en: : You’ll get used to it. I'm sure it will feel totally normal in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 你会习惯的。我肯定过不了多久你就会觉得完全正常。

lines.en: : I don’t think that it will.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得我会习惯。

lines.en: : Either way, what are you up to tonight?
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，你今晚在忙什么？

lines.en: scene toukahall3
: Well, I suppose I’m trying to understand exactly what I’m supposed to be doing here.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，我想我是在努力弄清自己到底该在这儿干什么。

lines.en: : It isn’t often that I have entire nights to myself and, somehow or another, I found myself feeling compelled to stand out in the hallway.
lines.zh: : 我很少有整个夜晚都属于自己，不知怎么的，我就鬼使神差地想站到走廊里来。

lines.en: : Part of me wants to try greeting the dejected looking girl slouched up against the wall, but she does not seem to want to be bothered.
lines.zh: : 我有点想去跟那个靠墙瘫坐、一脸落寞的女孩打个招呼，可她好像不想被人打扰。

lines.en: : I can tell you with absolute certainty that she definitely does not.
lines.zh: : 我可以百分百确定地告诉你，她绝对不想。

lines.en: : But on the bright side, you have me now. And I am extremely exciting and only mildly suspicious.
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想，你现在有我了。而我这个人超级有趣、只有一点点可疑。

lines.en: scene toukahall4
: That sounds a lot like something a suspicious person would say.
lines.zh: : 这话听着活像个可疑人物会说的。

lines.en: : I don’t think so. A really suspicious person probably wouldn’t say anything.
lines.zh: : 我不这么认为。真正可疑的人多半什么都不会说。

lines.en: : They’d just stand there and stare at you, probably from around a corner or something.
lines.zh: : 他们只会站在那儿盯着你，大概还躲在某个拐角什么的。

lines.en: scene toukahall5
: How bold of you to not utilize a corner at all and instead approach me with your suspicious behavior directly!
lines.zh: : 你可真大胆，压根不利用拐角，反倒直接把可疑行径凑到我跟前！

lines.en: : You are truly a man to be feared!
lines.zh: : 你真是个可怕的男人！

lines.en: : Again, you’ll get used to it and it will feel totally normal in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，你会习惯的，过不了多久就会觉得完全正常。

lines.en: scene toukahall6
: I somehow find the second utterance of that sentence even more disturbing than the first.
lines.zh: : 不知怎么，这句话你说第二遍，比第一遍还让我毛骨悚然。

lines.en: : So...go on. Out with it. What do you want or need from me tonight?
lines.zh: : 那么……说吧。讲出来。你今晚想从我这儿得到什么、或者需要什么？

lines.en: : I already told you, I’m just here to hang out. I’m going to do that from time to time now that you live here.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，我就是来逛逛的。既然你住在这儿，我以后会时不时来转转。

lines.en: scene toukahall2
: I understand that, but isn’t there some sort of objective you have in mind?
lines.zh: : 这我明白，但你心里总该有个什么目的吧？

lines.en: : I mean, absolutely. But there is no way you are anywhere near ready for what that objective is.
lines.zh: : 当然有。不过你离「准备好知道那个目的」还差得远。

lines.en: : Well, now I’m rather curious. Can you not explain it?
lines.zh: : 好吧，这下我更好奇了。你就不能解释一下吗？

lines.en: : Not without putting our future relationship in jeopardy.
lines.zh: : 解释了会危及我们俩未来的关系。

lines.en: : I understand. If it will have some sort of effect on my time in both the dorms and [kumon_mi_high], I’d rather keep it at bay for the time being.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。既然它会同时影响我在宿舍和[公文美高中]的日子，那我暂时还是别碰为好。

lines.en: : It’s hard enough getting adjusted to life in a place like this.
lines.zh: : 光适应这种地方的生活就够难的了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I imagine this is basically the exact opposite of what you’re used to.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我猜这儿基本上跟你习惯的生活完全相反。

lines.en: scene toukahall3
: I actually find it both endearing and mildly upsetting how so many girls are able to fit under one roof.
lines.zh: : 我居然觉得——这么多女孩能挤在同一个屋檐下——既可爱又有点不是滋味。

lines.en: : I’ve yet to see the inside of anyone else’s room, but mine seems rather...small for two people.
lines.zh: : 我还没见过别人房间里面什么样，但我这间……两个人住也太小了点。

lines.en: : They’re all the same size.
lines.zh: : 全都一样大。

lines.en: scene toukahall7
: And they expect us to live happily under these excruciatingly packed conditions?
lines.zh: : 然后他们就指望我们在这种挤得要命的条件下「幸福生活」？

lines.en: : Well, I don’t know if I’d say {i}happily,{/i} but yeah.
lines.zh: : 我说不上是不是{i}「幸福」{/i}，但差不多吧。

lines.en: : I guess it’s a lot easier if you don’t already have a bedroom that’s the size of this entire floor.
lines.zh: : 我猜，如果你原本的卧室不是有这一整层楼那么大，会好接受得多。

lines.en: : Yes, I do suppose that having exactly that may be skewing my judgement in some way.
lines.zh: : 是的，我想正是因为我家恰好是那样，多少影响了我的判断。

lines.en: : Hold on a second...I was being sarcastic.
lines.zh: : 等一下……我那是反讽。

lines.en: : You mean to tell me your bedroom is the size of this entire floor?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你的卧室真有这一整层楼那么大？

lines.en: scene toukahall3
: My first bedroom, absolutely. But my second and third are probably around the size of about...half?
lines.zh: : 我的第一间卧室，绝对有。不过我第二间和第三间，大概只有……一半那么大。

lines.en: : What use could you have for three bedrooms?
lines.zh: : 你要三间卧室干什么用？

lines.en: scene toukahall7
: Well, my first bedroom is where I keep all of my clothes and my...personal belongings. And the other two-
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，我的第一间卧室放我所有的衣服和……私人物品。另外两间——

lines.en: : Why would you say “personal belongings” after a pause like that? That just makes it sound like you’re hiding something inappropriate.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛在停顿之后说「私人物品」？这听着就像你藏了什么见不得人的东西。

lines.en: scene toukahall8
: Th-That’s not what I meant at all! I just have several things that you would likely make fun of me for owning, so I would rather not disclose them at this point in time!
lines.zh: : 我——我才不是那个意思！我只是有几样东西，你见了多半会取笑我，所以我现在不想透露！

lines.en: if toukastreets1 == True:
: That’s fine. I’m sure I’ll see whatever it is you’re hiding when I come over for that tea you promised me before.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正等你兑现之前答应请我喝茶时，我总会看见你藏了什么。

lines.en: : Absolutely not! As if I’d let {i}you{/i} of all people into my first bedroom!
lines.zh: : 绝对不行！我怎么会偏偏放{i}你{/i}进我的第一间卧室！

lines.en: else:
: That’s fine. It will just make finding out what you’re hiding from me all the more exciting when I finally get to see your “manor.”
lines.zh: : 没关系。等我终于见识到你的「大宅」时，发现你瞒着我的东西，只会更添几分乐趣。

lines.en: : You will do nothing of the sort! My first bedroom is still years and years away from accepting someone of the likes of you!
lines.zh: : 你休想！我的第一间卧室，要再等好多好多年，才可能接待你这种人！

lines.en: : What about the second and third bedrooms, then?
lines.zh: : 那第二间、第三间卧室呢？

lines.en: scene toukahall9
: Well...those are certainly closer to being within your reach than the first. But it would still be remarkably strange.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……那两间确实比第一间「离你更近」一点。但还是怪得不行。

lines.en: : I don’t think we’ve ever allowed anyone like you into the manor before, so we’d likely need to make special preparations of some sort.
lines.zh: : 我们好像从没放你这种人进过大宅，所以多半得做些特别的准备。

lines.en: : What sort of special preparations do you think “someone like me” would need, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你觉得「我这种人」到底需要什么样的特别准备？

lines.en: scene toukahall10
: Well, it’s...easy to get lost if you don’t understand where you’re going. So you would likely need a tour guide and-
lines.zh: : 就是……要是你不认识路，很容易迷路。所以你多半需要一个导游，而且——

lines.en: : You realize you could just show me around yourself, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你完全可以自己带我逛，对吧？

lines.en: scene toukahall11
: Well...I would not mind that at all. But I feel as if my father and the house staff would be quite disappointed if they found me doing a job like that.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……我倒是一点都不介意。只是我觉得，要是我父亲和宅里的佣人发现我干这种活，会相当失望。

lines.en: : Doing a job like that as opposed to?...
lines.zh: : 干这种活，而不是干什么？……

lines.en: scene toukahall12
: Studying to perfect both my academic and social skills.
lines.zh: : 而不是专心学习、打磨我的学业和社交能力。

lines.en: : You know, those things I relocated to this side of the city to pursue only to be derailed by a rogue teacher.
lines.zh: : 也就是那些——我特意搬到城的这一头来追求、却被一个不着调的老师带偏了的事。

lines.en: : Hey, that’s me. I’m the rogue teacher.
lines.zh: : 嘿，那就是我。我就是那个不着调的老师。

lines.en: : Yes. Yes you are.
lines.zh: : 对。你确实是。

lines.en: : I do hope you’re proud of yourself, as you have somehow managed to make my otherwise simple and peaceful life into something out of a Saturday morning cartoon.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你挺得意，因为你居然把我原本平静简单的生活，变成了周六早间卡通片里的剧情。

lines.en: : I’m surprised a girl of your “status” even knows what Saturday morning cartoons are.
lines.zh: : 我挺意外，你这「身份」的姑娘居然也知道什么是周六早间卡通。

lines.en: scene toukahall13
: Did I say...cartoon?! I meant Saturday morning...golf program!
lines.zh: : 我刚说……卡通？！我是说周六早间……高尔夫节目！

lines.en: : Those morning golfers...always causing a commotion for the...afternoon ones...
lines.zh: : 那些上午打高尔夫的……老是给……下午场的人……惹麻烦……

lines.en: scene toukahall14
: OKAY! GOODNIGHT!
lines.zh: : 好了！晚安！

lines.en: : Oh, come on. There’s no need to be embarrassed about not being seen as a proper lady for a minute or two.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。一两分钟没端住「淑女」的架子，也没什么好难为情的。

lines.en: scene toukahall10
: What in Heaven’s name are you saying, Sensei? Do you not realize who I am?
lines.zh: : 你到底在说什么，Sensei？你难道不清楚我是谁吗？

lines.en: : Of course I do, Tadako.
lines.zh: : 我当然清楚，Tadako。

lines.en: scene toukahall15
: Touka! Heir to the Tsukioka family’s fortune!
lines.zh: : Touka！月冈家财产的继承人！

lines.en: : I can not risk losing yet another teacher due to my inability to maintain my composure and-
lines.zh: : 我不能再因为端不住仪态而气跑又一位老师，然后——

lines.en: : Yet another?
lines.zh: : 又一位？

lines.en: scene toukahall9
: How is it that you’re able to set me off so easily with nothing more than immature teasing?
lines.zh: : 你怎么只凭几句幼稚的调侃，就能轻易把我惹毛？

lines.en: : Hold on, I’m curious about this apparent history of “losing teachers.”
lines.zh: : 等等，我对这段「气跑老师」的历史挺好奇。

lines.en: : Improper phrasing and spontaneous sentimentality. Please do not think much of it.
lines.zh: : 措辞失当、一时感伤罢了。请你别多想。

lines.en: scene toukahall7
: I apologize for my sudden departure, but I just realized that I still have matters to attend to tonight.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我突然要走，我刚意识到今晚还有事要处理。

lines.en: if toukastreets1 == True:
: But...if you’d still like to show me a little more about how things work on the outside world as we suggested before, you can always find me out and about early on the weekends.
lines.zh: : 不过……要是你还想照我们之前说的，多带我见识一下「外面的世界」，周末一大早你总能在外面找到我。

lines.en: else:
: Sudden matters like what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 到底突然有什么事？

lines.en: : Matters you need not concern yourself with as they do not have anything to do with you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你不必操心的事，反正跟你无关，Sensei。

lines.en: : Hold on, I-
lines.zh: : 等等，我——

lines.en: scene toukahall16
: I sincerely apologize, but I really can not talk any longer.
lines.zh: : 真的很抱歉，但我实在不能再聊了。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei. Please do be careful on the way home. It is rather dark outside right now.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei。回家路上请务必小心。外面现在很黑了。

lines.en: scene black
Touka disappears into her room and I’m left scratching my head in the hallway.
lines.zh: Touka 钻进自己的房间，留下我在走廊里挠头。

lines.en: Io looks up at me from her spot on the floor and, without saying much of anything, exchanges a glance that essentially asks, “Why are you talking to {i}her{/i} of all people?”
lines.zh: Io 从{i}她{/i}蹲坐的地儿抬头看我，没说几句话，只跟我交换了个眼神，那意思基本是：「你干嘛偏要跟她说话？」

lines.en: I shrug it off and ultimately hang out with Io instead for the next few minutes before finally deciding to head home.
lines.zh: 我耸耸肩没理，转而跟 Io 待了几分钟，最后才决定回家。

lines.en: I wonder what it is, if anything, that Touka so urgently needed to do tonight?
lines.zh: 不知道 Touka 今晚到底有什么急事——如果真有事的话。

lines.en: $ toukafirsthall = True
$ touka_love += 1
{i}Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Touka 的好感度提升到了 [touka_love]!{/i}
